pk <- function(navn) cat(sprintf("%-24s LC_CTYPE=%-32s UTF8=%s\n", navn,
  Sys.getlocale("LC_CTYPE"), l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]]))
pk("start")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse)); pk("tidyverse")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(knitr)); pk("knitr")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tsibble)); pk("tsibble")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(fable)); pk("fable+fabletools")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(feasts)); pk("feasts")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(urca)); pk("urca")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(distributional)); pk("distributional")
source("data/scripts/last_datapakke.R"); pk("source last_datapakke")
d <- last_alt("data"); pk("last_alt (readr/vroom)")
